column1: # Pairs the duplicate report should and should not group, against a discourse
# checkout.
# DRAFTED BY CLAUDE, NOT YET REVIEWED BY THE OWNER. Every verdict below was
# confirmed by reading both bodies against the labeling rule (DEC-020): a pair
# is a duplicate iff consolidating it would reduce net complexity.
# Where the rails set's pairs are library twins (String#first/#last), this
# corpus's are app twins: copied import scripts, plugin-to-plugin copies, and
# a class of exact collision rails does not have — schema migrations, where a
# byte-identical body is still not a consolidation candidate because migration
# files are frozen history.
# Copied wholesale between two abandoned-source import scripts.
ImportScripts::Muut#repair_json
# Byte-identical XML flattener in the ods and odt extractors.
DiscourseAi::Completions::OdsToText#collect_inline
# Identical; HEADER_ATTRS_FOR is a different table per job, and one parameter
# consolidates them — the write_query? judgment from the rails set.
Jobs::ExportCsvFile#get_header
# Identical; update_raw/update_cooked differ per job, so a shared mixin keeps
# behaviour intact — the connect/new_client shape from the rails set.
Jobs::ChangeDisplayName#update_post
# The same photo-prefix guessing copied between the two Vanilla importers.
BulkImport::Vanilla#find_photo_file
# Identical flag-permission check copied chat → post-voting; even the unused
# first parameter came along.
Chat::GuardianExtensions#can_flag_message_as?
# Identical but for the record parameter's name; one method taking the record
# consolidates them.
DiscourseAi::Translation::CategoryLocaleDetector.detect_locale
PostLocaleUpdater.validate_locale!
# Identical to the comment; only the comment's verb differs.
User::BulkDestroy#fetch_users
# modx.rb disabled its copies by prefixing `not_`; the bodies are byte-identical
# to vbulletin.rb's. A dead copy is the best kind of finding: the consolidation
# is deletion.
ImportScripts::VBulletin#close_topics
ImportScripts::VBulletin#import_private_messages
# --- migrations: byte-identical, DISTINCT, and the app-shaped sharp edge -----
# Schema migrations are frozen history: a migration file can never be merged
# into another, so an identical body is not a consolidation candidate and
# reporting it offers a refactor that must not happen (DEC-020). rails has no
# label in this class; an app corpus is full of them. The exact tier currently
# groups all five.
# The post_migrate copy re-runs the same batch update on purpose.
SetTypeAndTargetIdOnChatMentions#up
# One migration's `up` is a later migration's `down` — identical because each
# must independently restore the same state.
AddConstraintsToUserStat#up
FixCategorySlugsIndex#change
# Same settings-rename recipe, different RENAME_SETTINGS per migration.
RenameSsoSiteSettings#up
# up and down of ONE migration: inverse directions, never consolidatable.
# The near tier currently reports this pair at 0.83.
CommentMigration#up
# Every scorable's `query` emits this shape; the SQL inside is the entire
# behaviour and differs per scorable. The class hierarchy IS the consolidation.
DiscourseGamification::Solutions.query
# Same seeding scaffold, different payloads: one creates a thread, one only
# builds message params.
DiscourseDev::Thread#data
# Same fetch-from-source scaffold, but one imports over SQL and one over the
# API; the differing steps are the behaviour.
ImportScripts::Zendesk#import_posts
# --- true near-duplicates: copy-paste, then tweaked ---------------------------
# Each verified by reading both bodies. `near` means the NEAR tier must find it
# and the exact tier must not. Unlike the rails set — whose near labels were
# drawn from what the tier already reported — half of these were found by
# sweeping the threshold down to 0.55 and reading, so recall here measures the
# 0.80 threshold against the copy-paste population rather than against itself.
# One helper call differs: find_last_row(rows) against rows.to_a.last.
ImportScripts::PhpBB3::DatabaseBase#query
# Identical but for a default value on the parameter.
DiscourseReactions::PostReactionsQuery#ignored_users_filter_sql
# The post/topic twin: same pipeline, one content helper and one apply call
# differ. A two-argument helper consolidates it.
DiscourseAi::InferredConcepts::Applier#match_existing_concepts_for_post
# Two thin controller actions around load_change_request(:old)/(:new).
UsersEmailController#show_confirm_old_email
# discourse-ai copied chat's reviewable actions; one icon differs.
Chat::ReviewableMessage#build_combined_actions
# Copied, then one line of category defaulting dropped. Currently below the
# 0.80 threshold (0.69).
ImportScripts::Quandora#import_topic
# Same rescue-wrapped revision walk; only the key-presence guard differs.
# 9 lines put that one edit at 0.58 — far below the threshold.
Jobs::UpdateUsername#update_revision
# Copied mock, then a skip_body_check escape hatch added (0.69).
VllmMock#stub_streamed_response
# Copied batch importer plus one missing-topic guard block (0.73).
ImportScripts::Bespoke#import_post_batch!
# Copied chat → post-voting; one clause reads the edit time differently (0.63).
PostVoting::CommentReviewQueue#can_flag_again?
